run_fictitious_play_solver: run fictitious play on a game with configurable iterations and player count
create_xfpsolver_instance: create an XFPSolver instance from a loaded open_spiel game object
run_xfpsolver_iteration: run a single fictitious play iteration and update the solver state
calculate_exploitability: calculate exploitability of the solver's average policy against optimal play
load_game_with_pyspiel: load an open_spiel game by name with custom game parameters
